framing: Stage 4D was evaluated against the ERA5-Land reanalysis proxy. Stage 5 evaluates the frozen Stage 4D model against independent observations.
terminology: Observations are an independent validation source with their own errors (siting, instrument, reporting); ERA5-Land is a reanalysis proxy. Neither is treated as error-free.
karwar_exception: KARWAR EXCEPTION: Karwar is evaluated with 14 Panchayats and 5 ERA5-Land cells, below the frozen >= 6-cell criterion (E5L_14.90N_74.10E is sea; Majali 220655 and Mudgeri 220657 excluded).
primary_set_note: EMPTY: no ISD station lies inside an included Stage 4 Panchayat polygon. All results below are the NEARBY DIAGNOSTIC set and must not be read as Panchayat-level validation.

configuration.A1_bilinear: ERA5 bilinear value of the target variable; no training
configuration.A2_nearest: ERA5 nearest-point value of the target variable; no training
